# Public regression fixtures

Copied byte for byte from [libxgwx](https://github.com/ne0ekspert/libxgwx/tree/837ba63ec3cf6d00b040346a25be9ce417dff91b/fixtures)
at revision `837ba63ec3cf6d00b040346a25be9ce417dff91b`. These synthetic/native test projects are covered by
libxgwx's Apache-2.0 license; see [LICENSE](../../LICENSE) and
[third-party notices](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). `manifest.json` records
SHA-256 hashes for each file. Update the revision and hashes when refreshing
fixtures. Fixtures are excluded from the packaged extension.

The author-provided XGB Enet samples are not bundled: their permission is
limited to parser development and testing in the original repository.
